name: minimal-rnr-qa
description: [NAACL 2021] Designing a Minimal Retrieve-and-Read System for Open-Domain Question Answering

paragraphs: In open-domain question answering (QA), retrieve-and-read mechanism has the inherent benefit of interpretability and the easiness of adding, removing, or editing knowledge compared to the parametric approaches of closed-book QA models. However, it is also known to suffer from its large storage footprint due to its document corpus and index. Here, we discuss several orthogonal strategies to drastically reduce the footprint of a retrieve-and-read open-domain QA system by up to 160x. Our results indicate that retrieve-and-read can be a viable option even in a highly constrained serving…

This repository contains the code of the Minimal Retrieve & Read QA System that ranked the first place in the human (manual) evaluation and the second place in the automatic evaluation on "Systems Under 500Mb Track" of the NeurIPS 2020 EfficientQA competition.
features: Authors: Sohee Yang and Minjoon Seo
The demo normally takes 1-3 seconds for inference in the default setting, but ocassionally becomes slow according to the server condition.
